clue.text: Squire played tough man at chess

parts.note: tough and hard both mean difficult or unyielding
a castle, or rook, is one of the pieces (men) in chess

explanation.surface: A tough country gentleman sits down to a game of chess.
explanation.walkthrough: 'played' is a link hinting that this squire is a stage role: Squire Hardcastle in Goldsmith's comedy She Stoops to Conquer.
explanation.definitionFit: Hardcastle is the country squire of Goldsmith's play She Stoops to Conquer, a famous stage character.

clue.text: Tramp finds fairy ring

parts.note: a hob is a hobgoblin, a sprite or fairy
O is round like a ring

explanation.surface: A tramp comes upon a fairy ring of mushrooms.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fairy ring' looks like one thing, the mushroom circle, but splits into two pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: A hobo is an American vagrant, a homeless wanderer.

clue.text: Musical embellishment youngster included in Don Juan

indicators.note: included in says the word for youngster sits inside the word for a rake

parts.note: a roue is a debauched rake, like the legendary seducer Don Juan
a lad is a boy

explanation.surface: An opera singer's flourish includes a young boy in Mozart's Don Giovanni.
explanation.walkthrough: Don Juan is used generically for a womaniser, ROUE.
explanation.definitionFit: A roulade is a rapid run of notes sung on one syllable, a vocal flourish.

clue.text: Reprimand Falstaff, say, as idler

parts.note: to carpet someone is to call them in for a telling-off
Sir John Falstaff in Shakespeare is an example of a knight

explanation.surface: Tell off Falstaff for being a lazy layabout.
explanation.walkthrough: To carpet someone is British slang for calling them in to be scolded.
explanation.definitionFit: A carpet knight is a soldier who stays home in comfort, hence a lounger.

clue.text: Start of planning is about to alter this development area

indicators.note: to alter says the letters gathered are rearranged
start of picks the opening letter of the next word

explanation.surface: Beginning the planning process is going to change this housing zone.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to alter' rearranges P plus IS ABOUT. 'this' makes it read almost as one whole sentence describing the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Subtopia is sprawling suburban development on a city's fringe.

clue.text: A little folly can ultimately give rise to this

definitions.text: A little folly can ultimately give rise to this

indicators.note: in a down clue, rising means the letters read from bottom to top
a little of the words means a short run from inside them

explanation.surface: Small acts of foolishness can eventually lead to madness.
explanation.walkthrough: 'A little' picks YCANUL out of 'folly can ultimately', and 'give rise to' turns it upwards in this down entry.
explanation.definitionFit: Lunacy is madness, the extreme end of foolish behaviour.

clue.text: Name a poem that's uncommonly simple

parts.note: If is Kipling's famous poem

explanation.surface: A request to name a poem whose style is unusually plain.
explanation.walkthrough: The poem is Kipling's 'If', the crossword's favourite short poem title.
explanation.definitionFit: A naif is artless and unsophisticated, so unusually unworldly or innocent.

clue.text: Direction-finder old man needed in a situation

indicators.note: needed in says the word for old man is placed within another word

parts.note: the lie of the land is its situation
dad, or the old man, is father

explanation.surface: A navigational instrument is a must for a father in a difficult spot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'situation' is LIE as in the lie of the land.
explanation.definitionFit: An alidade is a sighting rule used in surveying to take bearings.

clue.text: Cook without a bird, it appears, for male company

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside places the cooking word around the rest

parts.note: to fry is to cook
a tern is a seabird
taken as written

explanation.surface: A cook apparently has no bird to serve for a gathering of men.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' is used in its old sense of outside, not lacking; 'it appears' just presents the word it.
explanation.definitionFit: A fraternity is a brotherhood, a society of men.

clue.text: Transatlantic prize for athlete — wife, also

parts.note: a Blue is a sportsman who has represented Oxford or Cambridge University
rib for wife alludes to Eve, made from Adam's rib
and means also, in addition

explanation.surface: A trophy goes to an athlete and his wife as well.
explanation.walkthrough: The Blue Riband was the honour held by the passenger liner making the fastest Atlantic crossing.
explanation.definitionFit: The Blue Riband was the honour held by the liner with the fastest Atlantic crossing.

clue.text: Test this city for liveliness

indicators.note: the clue reads 'this plus city stands for liveliness', so the word city comes off that synonym to leave the answer

parts.note: vivacity means liveliness or sparkle
taken as written

explanation.surface: An examiner tests a city to see how lively it is.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue says the answer followed by 'city' makes a word for liveliness: VIVA + CITY = VIVACITY. 'this' is the answer itself.
explanation.definitionFit: A viva is an oral examination, as taken by university students.

clue.text: For example. I plainly check funds

parts.note: to block something is to check or stop it
capital is money available for investment

explanation.surface: An example: I simply verify my finances.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is the letter I written plainly in an upper case form.
explanation.definitionFit: A plainly written upper-case I is an example of unjoined lettering in capitals.

clue.text: Ginger group of similar people

definitions.meaning: a ... of ginger is a root of the spice plant
a people sharing descent or characteristics

explanation.definitionFit: A race is a single root of the ginger plant, and also a group of people of common descent.

clue.text: Nothing adverse in new Conservative seat to produce swing

parts.note: O looks like zero, nothing

indicators.note: in says one piece is put inside another
new signals the letters of the following words are made afresh in a new order

parts.note: taken as written
ill means harmful or unfavourable, like adverse

explanation.surface: In a by-election, a new Conservative MP takes a seat with a swing against.
explanation.walkthrough: 'new' rearranges the Conservative letter and the seat into SCATE, and 'in' opens it after its second letter; the nothing-letter leads.
explanation.definitionFit: To oscillate is to move to and fro like a pendulum.

clue.text: Get into ground first, then consult this for details?

indicators.note: first says the piece for ground leads

parts.note: a score is a ground or reason, as in 'on that score'
to board a ship or bus is to get into it

explanation.surface: Arrive at the cricket ground, then look here to see how the game stands.
explanation.walkthrough: The scoreboard is what you check at a ground for the state of play.
explanation.definitionFit: A scoreboard displays the details of a match in progress.

clue.text: Records arrival to stop offence

parts.note: to check something is to stop or halt it
a sin is a moral offence

explanation.surface: A hotel desk logs a guest's arrival to prevent wrongdoing.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone checking in registers their arrival at a hotel or airport.

clue.text: Show something about the choir

definitions.meaning: to show a film is to put it on the ...
a partition enclosing the choir in a church

explanation.definitionFit: To screen a film is to show it; a choir screen is the partition around a church's choir.

clue.text: Runs into comet i.e variety of heavenly body

indicators.note: into says the letter for runs is put inside
variety signals a different arrangement of the letters before it

parts.note: R is the cricket abbreviation for runs

explanation.surface: Runs into a comet, a type of celestial object.
explanation.walkthrough: 'variety' reshuffles the comet letters to METEOIC, and 'into' opens that after its fifth letter. The definition is adjectival: belonging to a heavenly body.
explanation.definitionFit: Meteoric means relating to a meteor, a shooting star.

clue.text: Go for remedy

definitions.meaning: to go to a place, as in ... to the bar

explanation.definitionFit: To repair to somewhere is a formal way to go there; to repair damage is to remedy it.

clue.text: Young servant's hairstyle

definitions.meaning: a boy attendant, as at a hotel or wedding
a straight bob with the ends curled under

explanation.definitionFit: A pageboy is a boy attendant and also a bob haircut with the ends turned under.

clue.text: Mixed up the cases in Jack's luggage

indicators.note: mixed up says the letters of the words that follow are jumbled

explanation.surface: Someone muddled the suitcases belonging to Jack.
explanation.walkthrough: Jack is a sailor (Jack tar), whose box for belongings is a sea chest.
explanation.definitionFit: A sea chest is a sailor's storage box for belongings, and Jack is a crossword sailor.

clue.text: Rousing stuff as concert's ending in symphony

indicators.note: in places the closing letter inside the symphony

parts.note: the Eroica is Beethoven's third symphony

indicators.note: ending picks the last letter of the word before

explanation.surface: Something stirring for a concert's finale in a symphony.
explanation.walkthrough: EROICA is Beethoven's Third Symphony; 'Rousing' is sexually arousing rather than stirring.
explanation.definitionFit: Erotica is literature or art meant to arouse desire.

clue.text: Doctor one found in Florence's family

parts.note: a medic is a doctor
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A doctor was discovered in a Florentine household.
explanation.definitionFit: The Medici were the ruling dynasty of Renaissance Florence.

clue.text: Notable moon?

definitions.meaning: playfully, the moon is said to be made of cheese, and it is large

explanation.definitionFit: A big cheese is a VIP; the moon, said to be made of cheese, is literally a large one.

clue.text: Voting method of chairperson

parts.note: PR is proportional representation, an electoral system

explanation.surface: How the chair of a committee casts a vote.
explanation.walkthrough: A professor holds a chair, a university post, hence 'chairperson'.
explanation.definitionFit: A university professor holds a chair, so the professor is in that sense a chairperson.

clue.text: Delay a guy

definitions.meaning: a rope or wire bracing a mast or tent

explanation.definitionFit: A stay of execution is a postponement; a stay is also a rope bracing a mast.

clue.text: Cleric born in Lincoln

indicators.note: in says the letter for born goes inside the president's name

parts.note: Abe is the short first name of President Abraham Lincoln

explanation.surface: A clergyman who was born in the city of Lincoln.
explanation.walkthrough: Lincoln looks like the English city; it is Abraham Lincoln, ABE.
explanation.definitionFit: An abbe is a French abbot or ecclesiastic.

clue.text: Producer of books including bitter letters in catalogue

indicators.note: in places the rearranged letters within the list

parts.note: a list is a catalogue or inventory

indicators.note: bitter letters means the letters of bitter, taken in a new order

explanation.surface: A publisher puts sour correspondence into its catalogue.
explanation.walkthrough: 'letters' reshuffles the bitter word to BRETTI, which 'in' places after the second letter of the catalogue. The books are librettos, Italian for little books.
explanation.definitionFit: A librettist writes the words of an opera, a libretto, literally a little book.

clue.text: Lifetime's confusion, we hear

definitions.note: plural noun read as the possessive word, meaning one's whole life

indicators.note: we hear signals the word is identified by how it sounds when spoken

parts.note: a daze is a state of confusion

explanation.surface: A whole life is one long muddle, so we are told.
explanation.definitionFit: One's days, as in 'all my days', is a whole span of life.

clue.text: Varied collection in heaps round one's little room

indicators.note: round says the word for heaps goes around the other pieces

parts.note: heaps, informally, means many
one's is I plus S, one is
a cell is a small room

explanation.surface: An assortment of things is piled up around a tiny cell of one's own.
explanation.walkthrough: 'round' wraps the heaps word around the rest, splitting after its first letter; 'in' is only a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A miscellany is a mixed assortment of items or writings.
